mapper.sql: SELECT b.id, b.project_id AS projectId, p.name AS projectName, b.sprint_id AS sprintId, s.name AS sprintName, b.title, b.content, b.severity, b.priority, b.status, b.steps, b.expected_result AS expectedResult, b.actual_result AS actualResult, b.assignee, b.reporter, b.fix_version AS fixVersion, b.resolved_at AS resolvedAt, b.created_at AS createdAt, b.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM bug b LEFT JOIN project p ON b.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN sprint s ON b.sprint_id = s.id
mapper.select: WHERE b.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY b.created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bug WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bug WHERE severity = #{severity}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bug (project_id, sprint_id, title, content, severity, priority, status, steps, expected_result, actual_result, assignee, reporter, fix_version, resolved_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{sprintId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{severity}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{steps}, #{expectedResult}, #{actualResult}, #{assignee}, #{reporter}, #{fixVersion}, #{resolvedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE bug SET sprint_id = #{sprintId}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, severity = #{severity}, priority = #{priority}, status = #{status}, steps = #{steps}, expected_result = #{expectedResult}, actual_result = #{actualResult}, assignee = #{assignee}, reporter = #{reporter}, fix_version = #{fixVersion}, resolved_at = #{resolvedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE bug SET status = #{status}, resolved_at = #{resolvedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
